communications.subject: Nevada Public Records Act Request: On Campus NV
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting an opportunity to inspect or obtain copies of public records that relate to correspondence between representatives of the Federal Bureau of Investigation and academic officials at University of Nevada Las Vegas regarding concerns surrounding domestic extremism, broadly construed. 

In particular, I seek access to electronic records of any and all email correspondence between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed between representatives of the Federal Bureau of Investigation ("FBI") and the Office of the President; and any and all correspondence from the same date between representatives of the FBI and representatives of the following academic departments at University of Nevada Las Vegas: History, Anthropology, and English. Please also include the following personnel in your search: Jan Jones Blackhurst, Constance Brooks, Deanna Merino Contino, Lakshmi Reddi, B. Keith Roger, and Heather Torgersen.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Daniel Boguslaw

title: ACD Extract Report files, all Arkansas counties (26 CAR § 213-202)

communications.subject: Arkansas Freedom of Information Act Request: ACD Extract Report files, all Arkansas counties (26 CAR § 213-202)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arkansas Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

A copy of the ACD Extract Report files that Arkansas counties submitted to the Assessment
Coordination Division by January 31, 2026, under 26 CAR § 213-202: the electronic file of all real
property appraised, one row per deed, covering deeds from the prior three calendar years, for all 75
counties or whichever counties the Division holds, together with the code lists submitted with them
(deed types, property types and sales validation codes).

If the Division still holds the equivalent files submitted by January 31, 2024 and January 31,
2025, please include those as well.

An electronic copy in the format the files are held (Excel or CSV), by email or download link, would
be ideal.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Noah DuBois
